notes: The sfl2vl evaluation build is limited to 500 input lines. Large modules (R3000A, GTE, GPU, CDROM, core) cannot be processed by it; do not work around this limit.
Repo files are MIT (root LICENSE, pgate1). APF files are Analogue SLA and are not redistributed.
The Overtone licence and APF distribution licence are open decisions; they are not resolved here.
Syntax/elaboration checks (iverilog) are not a complete Pocket project build. The end-to-end build remains blocked.
